company.name: Zywa
company.shortDescription: Zywa provides a mobile banking app and prepaid card for Gen Z to manage money, set goals, and track spending.
company.description: Zywa provides a digital financial platform designed to help younger users manage their money. The company offers tools that enable spending, saving, and earning through a mobile app tailored for Gen Z users and supported by parental access. Its platform includes spending insights, transaction notifications, and bill payment features with cashback incentives. The service incorporates security measures such as 3D Secure standards and automated fraud monitoring to protect user transactions.
